architectural_fidelity.reason: Room is recognizable but significant alterations: original textured ceiling preserved with LED strips maintained (excellent), but walls appear darker/grayer than original white/light gray, ceiling height feels compressed, and window position/blackout curtain entirely removed - viewpoint maintained but architectural liberties taken

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture completely removed - no ghost outlines of bed, desk, gaming chair, guitars, or computer equipment; floor clear of remnants with only intentional new staging present

style_commitment.reason: Unmistakably industrial: exposed metal bed frame with weathered/rusted finish, Edison bulb pendants, concrete-look flooring, metal shelving, raw materials throughout - this is definitively industrial aesthetic, not generic neutral staging

editorial_density.reason: Moderate styling present: wall art (framed piece right wall), plants (3+ locations including shelf and floor), industrial task lamp, shelf vignette with books/plants, multiple light sources (LED strips, pendants, task lamp), layered bedding - approaches editorial level but lighter than Collov's richly layered textiles and fuller accessorizing

photorealism.reason: Lighting coherent with preserved LED strips and warm Edison bulbs creating atmospheric glow, industrial materials reasonably rendered, but bed frame perspective slightly awkward (metal drawer/box construction unclear), some shadow softness, and overall moody darkness masks potential texture issues - competent but not quite Collov's crisp realism

designer_preference_reason: Cova delivers a distinctive, client-ready industrial design with authentic style commitment that would resonate with target buyers, whereas Collov's generic contemporary staging lacks memorable character despite technical polish.
what_cova_does_better: Bold stylistic differentiation - unmistakably industrial vs generic contemporary
Preserved original architectural character (textured ceiling, LED strips)
Authentic material palette (weathered metal, concrete, raw wood) with design conviction
Atmospheric lighting design that enhances industrial mood
what_collov_does_better: Sharper photorealistic rendering with crisper material definition
Fuller editorial density with more layered textiles and accessory richness
Cleaner architectural presentation with refined proportions
Brighter, market-ready staging that photographs well for listings
